text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, yo, check it out, say yeah for the 
b-day♪ Everybody celebrate♪ Sing it out, 
yeah yeah♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
My will to win is unshakeable♪ When I win, 
smooth bean paste shake for me♪

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So cyute♪ Mega strong♪ Seriously the best♪ 
Tosen Jordan, super congratz-an!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Pfft, ahahaha! What is that, a 
homemade rap from the two of you!?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, gross. I mean, isn't a "Smooth Red 
Bean Shake" way too heavy after a race??

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah—, you think so too? I was torn on that 
right up until the end~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's hilarious, so I'm totally down! 
Big thanks to both of you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy ayy ayyy~! Just bagged a super 
hype result! Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Man, I should've recorded a video of that. 
...When I win, I'm havin' a smooth bean 
paste shake♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No way! You actually remembered!? We gotta 
do it together, the three of us!? We gotta 
record a video!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm down, I'm down~ For now, just send the 
lyrics on LANE.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, yo, check it out, say yeah for the 
b-day♪"
